services.name: Holiday Party Rentals
services.desc: Host your holiday cocktail party at Milwaukee's iconic Pabst Mansion. Available Monday through Wednesday evenings during the holiday season, the Mansion provides a one-of-a-kind venue for corporate holiday parties, nonprofit celebrations, client appreciation events, and private cocktail receptions. Surrounded by stunning holiday décor in a historic setting, your guests will enjoy an unforgettable Milwaukee holiday experience. Don't miss out on the chance to host a truly unforgettable event at the historic Pabst Mansion this holiday season. The Pabst Mansion can host up to 90 guests at one time.
